## TL;DR

Copilot’s retired `efficiency` Auto tier broke default `github copilot` runs. RepoOS now maps `default` and legacy `copilot-auto-efficiency` to `--auto-tier balance`, centralizes tier argv in `src/core/copilot-auto-tier.ts`, and enriches Copilot-only tier failures with Agents-page guidance. Review round 2 scoped that enrichment to `github copilot` only and tightened matchers so other harnesses’ “unavailable” errors pass through unchanged.

## Work and rationale

Shared `resolveCopilotAutoTier` / `copilotAutoTierModelArgs` feed both `modelArgs` in `src/server/agents.ts` and the Copilot contract probes. `oneShotFailureDetail(stderr, output, cli?)` applies `formatCopilotAutoTierFailure` only when `cli === "github copilot"`; `runPrompt`, `oneShotResultFromLog`, and `testModelCombination` pass the harness id. Tier failure detection requires Copilot-shaped phrases (Auto profile/preference, `--auto-tier`), not bare “unavailable.” User-facing copy points at Settings → Agents model choices, not CLI flags.

`DEFAULT_PROBE_MODELS` for Copilot is `default` (same balance mapping); `copilot-auto-efficiency` remains a runtime alias. Docs avoid unverified “lowest cost” and fixed retirement dates.

## Approaches tried

Dual fix for the review bug: cli gating plus stricter regex, with a negative test using Claude-style unavailable text.

## Challenges and blockers

No live Copilot tier probe in this session (credits). Human can confirm via Agents test after merge.

## Key learnings

Harness-specific error rewriting must always receive harness context; generic substring rules are unsafe across CLIs.
